report.summary: The 'literals' layer fails to detect change_constant mutants because _module_literals only inspects top-level Assign/AnnAssign nodes, missing constants inside class bodies, if blocks, etc. Since many such mutants modify class-level defaults or conditionally-defined constants, they produce no delta. The fix broadens _module_literals to recursively walk the AST, skipping functions (handled separately) to capture all module-level constants without false alarms.
risks: Extending _module_literals may uncover pre-existing constants that were previously ignored (e.g., in try/except blocks), but these reflect real source changes and should not increase false positives on real commits.
If a constant change occurs inside a function but is also duplicated at module level, it could be double-counted, but the merged set-based diff ignores duplicates.
todos: Update _module_literals to recursively walk tree.body, skipping FunctionDef nodes, and processing Assign/AnnAssign at any depth.
Confirm with mutation corpus that changed class constants now appear in the 'literals' layer delta.
